subject: Urgent: Launch credit request — product timeline mismatch
messages:
From: Sam Rogers <sam.rogers@nimblepay.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Production rollout delay — request for transitional credit

Hi Laura and Monica,

Quick note from NimblePay — we hit a blocker in our integration that prevents prefetch KV from persisting across warm restarts. The feature was critical for latency-sensitive flows in our payments UI; because of the gap we need to push launch by ~6 weeks. This has material commercial impact for us since we timed a paid pilot to go live this month.

We want to be transparent: the delay means we’ll need to extend our internal incentives to merchants and that increases our estimated cost for November and December. Is Redwood able to consider a short-term credit or rebate tied to this delayed capability until the prefetch persistence fix lands? We prefer a simple 2-month credit tied to actual usage.

I can share our SOW and usage snapshot — attaching a summary. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Sam Rogers
Head of Integrations, NimblePay

Attachments: SOW_NimblePay_v2.pdf (summary), usage_report_q4.csv (sampling)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Sam Rogers <sam.rogers@nimblepay.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-10T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Production rollout delay — request for transitional credit

Sam — thanks for the heads up and for sending the SOW/usage snapshot. Really sorry you’re blocked here.

Short answer: we can evaluate a short, timeboxed commercial accommodation while the prefetch persistence fix is being shipped. To move this quickly I need: 1) a one-page summary of the expected incremental merchant cost (approx $ delta/month) and 2) confirmation of the new proposed launch date.

Operationally, our typical path for something like this is: CS/Account -> Sales (review) -> Product (timeline / mitigation) -> Exec approval for any credit >$X or longer than 2 months. I’ve looped in Karthik from Product so we get a timeline, and Monica from CS for usage/impact verification.

Propose we target a decision by 11/15. Would you be available for a 30-min sync on 11/11 or 11/12?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: Production rollout delay — request for transitional credit (NimblePay)

Forwarding NimblePay thread + our usage/impact analysis. Quick notes:

- Customer is a mid-market partner ramping to ~200k calls/day at peak; current monthly bill run-rate ~$28k.
- Attach usage extract and the SOW (see attachments).
- Customer requests 2-month credit tied to usage while prefetch persistence is absent. They estimate incremental merchant incentives ~ $12k/month.

Recommendation (CS): offer a temporary credit capped at 50% of the incremental merchant spend (so ~ $6k/month) for two months, contingent on the fix landing by 2027-12-15. This is a conservative interim; we want to retain goodwill and keep the pilot.

Requesting Product and Revenue approval to proceed to Exec sign-off if needed.

Attachments: usage_report_q4.csv, SOW_NimblePay_v2.pdf

— Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-13T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NimblePay — prefetch persistence fix ETA and suggested commercial plan

Laura / Monica — quick product update after engineering triage:

- Root cause: KV cache eviction on warm restart when prefetch is used with long-lived sessions; patch requires changes to cache checkpointing and a release of runtime 1.9.2.
- ETA: engineering estimates ship to staged clusters by 2027-12-10 and GA by 2027-12-18 (contingent on one more integration test).
- Risk: medium. If test fails we may slip another 2 weeks.

Given that, the suggested commercial offer to keep NimblePay on track:
- Transitional credit equal to 10% of monthly Redwood bill for two billing cycles, or capped at $7,500/month (whichever is lower).
- Credit only applies to baseline usage for the pilot (we’ll exclude experimental spikes).
- Condition: fix ships to GA by 2027-12-18; if not, we re-open conversation.

If Sales/CS are aligned I recommend we escalate for executive approval (Rishi) due to the $ cap and precedent risk. I can provide a short technical note for legal/finance if needed.

— Karthik Iyer
VP, Product — Inference Runtime

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, finance-billing@redwood.ai, legal@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-15T17:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NimblePay — Exec decision on transitional credit

Thanks for the context and the clear recommendation. I approve the transitional credit under the following conditions: 1) Cap at $7,500/month for two months as proposed; 2) Include a one-sentence amendment to the MSA stating the credit is timeboxed and contingent on GA by 2027-12-18; 3) CS to provide final incremental cost justification on company letterhead; 4) Finance to process the credit as a contra-invoice, not a cash refund.

Monica / Laura — please coordinate with Legal to prepare the short amendment and with Finance to queue the contra-invoice. Karthik, if engineering slips the GA date we’ll re-evaluate the hold.

Rishi
COO, Redwood Inference
